candidate_workaround: Run repository-scoped Git probes from the resolved owned worktree, not from the configuration directory.
failure_signature: A read-only git worktree list was invoked from a non-repository directory and returned not-a-repository.
recurrence_guard: Resolve the owned worktree first, then bind every repository-scoped Git probe to that workdir.
rollback: Retain the failed read at zero credit and perform no mutation before a worktree-bound Git probe passes.
title: Bind Git probes to the resolved owned worktree
trigger_preconditions: A Git command depends on repository discovery and the current wrapper directory may be outside the repository.
